inputs.body:
Hi Iris,

I wanted to share what I learned at the cooking class last night. We made homemade pasta from scratch and a rich, flavorful Bolognese sauce. The chef, Maria, showed us how to get the pasta dough texture just right — the right flour-to-egg ratio, thorough kneading until smooth, resting the dough, and rolling it thin before cutting into ribbons (we made tagliatelle). For the Bolognese, Maria emphasized a slow-simmer with a soffritto base (onion, carrot, celery), a mix of beef and pork, a splash of wine, and a long gentle simmer to concentrate the flavors.

I loved the class and Maria’s tips for perfecting the dough. If you’d like, I can send the full recipe and steps or cook it for us sometime.

Thanks,
[Your Name]
